answer: Require every agent to lock a refundable stake before it can trade, then earn weight only through audited work over time. Like timber stacked on a ridge, reputation grows slowly, one verified job at a time, and even a whisper of fraud triggers slashing of the stake. An attacker spawning thousands of fake agents must fund each identity and wait out the same slow climb, so attack cost scales with the fake fleet while honest agents keep their deposits.
